theme_and_art_direction.vibe: Premium, technical, aggressive yet luxurious. It should feel like an editorial fashion magazine designed for high-end audiophiles and tech enthusiasts.
principles: Negative Space: Massive gaps between sections (py-32, py-40) to let typography breathe.
Tension: Use stark asymmetry in product grids.
Contrast: Pure stark white typography on deep void black backgrounds.
The 'E1' Twist: No purple gradients. No soft glowing orbs. Hard lines, 1px white/10% borders, and cinematic spotlighting on products.

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-[8vw] leading-[0.85] tracking-tighter uppercase

rules: Headings MUST use tight tracking and ultra-tight line-height.
Overlines and small labels MUST use the mono font with wide tracking.
Do NOT use Inter or Roboto for headings.

motion_and_interactions.lenis: MANDATORY. Wrap the entire app or main layout in @studio-freight/react-lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.hero_kinetic_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using framer-motion. Wrap each line of text in an overflow-hidden span. The inner text translates from y: '100%' to y: '0%' with a custom cubic-bezier ease (e.g., [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1]) over 1.2s.
motion_and_interactions.scroll_reveals: Use framer-motion `whileInView` for sections. Fade up slightly (y: 40 to 0) with low opacity starting point.
motion_and_interactions.parallax_hero: Use framer-motion `useScroll` and `useTransform` to make a hero background image (the abstract chrome) move at a different speed than the scroll. Add a slight mouse-follow transform for extra 3D feel.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Product cards: image slightly scales up (scale: 1.05), border brightness increases.

navigation.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/60 border-b border-white/10 px-8 py-4 flex justify-between items-center

hero.structure: Full height (min-h-screen). Absolute positioning for the abstract 3D chrome background image (masked and parallaxed). Front layer: massive H1 masked reveal text.
hero.instruction: Do not center align. Left align the massive text. Bottom-left or bottom-right place a small scroll indicator.

marquee.style: Editorial Ribbon. bg-transparent border-y border-white/10 py-4. Text: text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[#888890]. Separated by small '+' icons.

manifesto_chapters.layout: Use grid. Left col (or background): massive numbers (text-[15vw]) using `-webkit-text-stroke: 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.2)` and `color: transparent`. Right col: overlapping body text.
manifesto_chapters.instruction: This creates depth. The text should sit partially on top of the massive outline numbers.

product_grid.style: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris). Cllipped/spotlight frames.
product_grid.card_classes: relative group overflow-hidden bg-[#111111] p-8 flex flex-col justify-end min-h-[500px]
product_grid.image_treatment: Product image centered, heavily spotlighted (use radial-gradient background or pure black blending).
product_grid.hover: On hover, fade in 'Add to Cart' button and slightly scale image.

hero_parallax_abstract.description: Abstract metallic spiral. Use as a large, subtle parallax background element in the hero.

product_headphones_1.description: Sleek wireless headphones on dark background

universal_guidelines: NO DEFAULT AI SLOP: Do not use standard centered headers with generic gradients.
SPACING: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
TRANSITIONS: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties to avoid breaking Framer Motion transforms.
HTML STRUCTURE: Never center align the main App container globally.
DATA ATTRIBUTES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
